verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a Trust Center where admins choose which content to show or hide and gate documents behind NDAs. The platform separately keeps some of the underlying data current: the vendor list is updated through SSO shadow-IT detection, and controls are tested daily. However, no evidence shows that this platform data automatically flows into the public Trust Center; the documented Trust Center workflow is admin-curated. Missing for 10: documented automatic sync of the subprocessor list to the Trust Center, automatic document renewal or expiry handling, live control-status display on the Trust Center, and independent corroboration.
